subject: [hw] K02 final: reverted the rev-5 one-line tweak; the accepted sha a939f107 is what is in the tree
body:
To keep the accepted artifact exact: I reverted the rev-5 defensive cap tweak in n2vc_slot_close_all (it changed nothing for the only caller, and R2 had just accepted a939f107). kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc is back to sha256 a939f107bef82e02..., which is the file R2 accepted (588871/588871).

  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST K02 PASS 588871/588871 (violations 0) x2
  staged kernel compile: clean, 1,318,688-byte object, 9 new undefined symbols vs q10at3, 0 unknown.

So: rev 3/4 content + SPDX in the test harness = final. No further changes from me unless a reviewer finds something. 0299 regen + compile_check is IK's step.
